disambiguation: Basketball Zero was previously called Basketball Rivals. Several competitor pages still publish under the old name, and a few mix in codes from other anime basketball games on Roblox.
redeem_path: Launch Basketball Zero, tap the Codes button on the bottom button bar, type the code into the box, then press Redeem.
redeem_requirements: Like the game on its Roblox page and join the official Basketball Zero Roblox group. Codes will not redeem without both.

official_sources.note: carries update logs, sneak peeks and codes

codes.requirements: none beyond the group join and game like
codes.notes: Two independent trackers agree on the string, the reward and the 15 August add date.

codes.requirements: 15 minutes of in-game time before the code will redeem
codes.notes: The 15 minute playtime gate is the most common reason this one returns an error. Competitor lists rarely mention it.
Part of the 30 and 1HR prefixed family below.
This game ships codes in families: a base code, a 30 prefixed version and a 1HR prefixed version, each gated behind that much playtime.

codes.reward: spins after an hour of playtime
5 Lucky Style Spins and 5 Lucky Zone Spins
20 Lucky Style Spins and 10 Lucky Zone Spins

codes.notes: Compensation code after a server restart, a recurring pattern for this developer.

next_drop.pattern: New codes land roughly every two days and track update releases. Most updates ship a base code plus a 30 minute and a 1 hour playtime variant, and server restarts usually produce an apology code within hours.
watch: official Basketball Zero Discord, update log and codes channels
